name: Electricity disconnection notice
text:
LAKEVIEW POWER SUPPLY CO.  (fictional sample)
NOTICE OF DISCONNECTION
Consumer No: 1100234567
Date: 18/11/2026

Dear Consumer,
Our records show that your electricity bill of Rs. 2,340.00 for the month of October 2026 remains unpaid. The due date was 05/11/2026.
Please pay the outstanding amount on or before 30/11/2026 to avoid disconnection of supply. A late payment surcharge of Rs. 50 will be added to your next bill.
If supply is disconnected, a reconnection fee of Rs. 150 will be charged.
You can pay at any Lakeview service centre or through the official Lakeview app. Lakeview staff will never ask for your OTP or bank PIN.
If you have already paid, please ignore this notice.

Assistant Engineer, Ward 7 Office

name: School circular: fees + parent meeting
text:
GREENFIELD PUBLIC SCHOOL (fictional)
Circular No. 47/2026-27            Date: 20 November 2026

Dear Parents,
1. The Parent-Teacher Meeting for Classes VI to X will be held on Saturday, 12 December 2026, from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Attendance of at least one parent is compulsory.
2. Term 2 fees of ₹8,500 must be paid by 10 December 2026 through the school fee portal or at the school office. A late fee of ₹200 per week will be charged after the due date.
3. Students must bring their signed report card on the day of the meeting.

Principal

text: Dear Costumer, Your Electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 pm from electricity office because your previous month bill was not update. Please immediately contact with our electricity officer 90000 00000 and share the OTP you receive to update your bill. Thank you

name: Bank letter, explained in Hindi
text:
RIVERSIDE COOPERATIVE BANK (fictional)
Date: 22-11-2026

Dear Customer,
As per regulatory guidelines, your KYC (Know Your Customer) details are due for periodic update. Please visit your home branch with a valid photo ID and address proof on or before 15-01-2027. If KYC is not updated by this date, transactions in your savings account may be restricted.
The bank will never ask for your password, PIN or OTP over phone, SMS or email.

Branch Manager
